texto_para_tela: ≈ 150 MILKINGS PER VIAL · JANUARY 2026: ABOUT HALF ITS USUAL FUNNEL-WEB SPIDERS (sugestão)
nota: F216–F221 relidos: 'It takes approximately 150 individual venom milkings to produce a single vial of antivenom'; 'during the 2020 lockdowns, movement restrictions meant almost no funnel-web spiders or egg sacs were donated'; 'the Australian Reptile Park is now operating at around half of its usual funnel-web spider capacity'. FORMA: o parque fala de CAPACIDADE DE ARANHAS ('funnel-web spider capacity'), não de estoque de soro. A voz diz 'down to about half its usual supply', o que o contexto liga às aranhas; a tela deve dizer aranhas ('SPIDERS'), não 'SUPPLY' sozinho, para não sugerir falta de soro.
licenca: fato com atribuição ('the park says'); parte interessada; fotos do parque não são fonte aprovada

grafias_do_espelho: JANUARY 2026: ABOUT HALF THE USUAL SUPPLY (AP: mês só com o ano, por extenso; r2, DF-07)
Source: Australian Reptile Park, Jan. 13, 2026 (o crédito fica com a data inteira, abreviada pelo AP)
texto_aprovado: It takes about 150 milkings to make a single vial, so the park needs spiders, and it gets them from its neighbors. It asks people around Sydney, the Central Coast and Newcastle to catch the funnel-webs they find, safely, and bring them in. During the COVID lockdowns, almost no spiders were donated. In January 2026, the park said it was down to about half its usual supply.
